recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is for FHIR-32077. Any cleanup of older DICOM extension examples in other resources should be handled under a separate issue and work-group decision, not under this ImagingStudy clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-32077 was Published with a Persuasive resolution for FHIR-core ImagingStudy. It asked to add commentary discouraging extensions for additional DICOM attributes and instead explain how to access metadata-only content through DICOMweb, including an example.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 52a5df179457fea03c4c8e598133c470f4e1de38, a November 2021 ImagingStudy update that names FHIR-32077 and added the Additional DICOM attributes section plus a WADO-RS metadata retrieval example to source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-notes.xml.
additional_context: The Confluence resolution page contains the same guidance and example shape now present in the source. source/fhir.ini lists imagingstudy as an active resource, placing source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-notes.xml in build scope. A later 2026 edit only linked the Endpoint reference and preserved the metadata guidance. The originating Zulip thread records WG consensus favoring metadata-only WADO retrieve over arbitrary ImagingStudy extensions for extra DICOM attributes.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current lines 190-242 of source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-notes.xml include the Additional DICOM attributes section, WADO-RS metadata-only recommendation, rationale that publishers need not know each consumer's future attributes, and a concrete /metadata request example.
